concept_description: A machine that recognizes spoken words and carries out spoken commands, such as voice-operated doors or computers.
milestone_summary: Threshold Technology (Delran/Cinnaminson, NJ) brought out the VIP-100 isolated-word recognizer and had voice-input terminals working in industrial, government and military 'real-world' use from late 1972.
